definition: In digital lexicography, natural language processing, and digital humanities, a lexical resource is a language resource consisting of data regarding the lexemes of the lexicon of one or more languages e.g., in the form of a database..

story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. In plain words: In digital lexicography, natural language processing, and digital humanities, a lexical resource is a language resource consisting of data regarding the lexemes of the lexicon of one or more languages e.g., in the form of a database.. Here is how it actually plays out: In digital lexicography, natural language processing, and digital humanities, a lexical resource is a language resource consisting of data regarding the lexemes of the lexicon of one or more languages e.g., in the form of a database. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is Lexical resource.
